Settings.title: Settings
Settings.description: Mosa stores your catalog and history locally.
Settings.confirmHistory: Clear all history? Favorites will be kept.
Settings.local: Local application. No streaming service is provided.
Settings.appearanceDescription: Choose how Mosa looks. This preference is saved on this device.
Settings.formatNote: The source determines the video format. Choosing M3U or HTML cannot convert a stream. Direct MPEG-TS may not work in this browser.
Settings.providerDescription: This profile has at most one source. Create another profile to use another source.
Settings.unchanged: Leave blank to keep the current value
Settings.confirmRemove: Remove {name}? Its catalog, favorites, and viewing history will be deleted.
Settings.deviceDescription: Random identifier for this Mosa installation.
Settings.macNote: This is not a physical MAC address and does not authenticate MAG/Stalker portals.
Settings.pwaNote: Installation still requires a reachable Next.js server; external video is not available offline.
Settings.restoreChannel: Restore last channel when opening Live TV
Settings.qrNote: This QR contains only this installation ID. It does not grant access or authenticate anyone; device pairing requires a reachable, protected server with temporary codes.
Settings.passwordSafety: The saved password is not loaded until you select the eye icon. Leave blank to keep it.
Settings.remoteExplanation: Want to use the same catalog on another device? A provider MAC cannot do that. Use the invitation QR below: both devices access this Mosa without copying playlists. An owner password and reachable HTTPS address are required; the server stays local by default.
Settings.aboutDetails: Mosa organizes authorized sources and data on your local server. It does not provide subscriptions, streams, DRM, media relaying or transcoding. Availability, EPG and compatibility depend on your provider and browser.
Settings.copyright: © 2026 Mosa. All rights reserved. Trademarks, artwork and videos belong to their respective owners.
Settings.formatDescription: Used by Xtream sources without an override. This does not transcode streams.
